description: This file defines the public APIs and data structures for the eSPI SAF (Serial Flash Access Framework) driver in the Zephyr project. It includes function prototypes, callback management, configuration structures, and documentation for interacting with eSPI flash components and related hardware.

methods.name: espi_saf_config
methods.description: Configures the eSPI SAF controller with specified settings.

methods.name: espi_saf_set_protection_regions
methods.description: Overrides default flash protection regions of the SAF controller.

methods.name: espi_saf_activate
methods.description: Activates the SAF block after configuration.

methods.name: espi_saf_get_channel_status
methods.description: Checks if the SAF channel is ready.

methods.name: espi_saf_flash_read
methods.description: Reads data from the attached flash component.

methods.name: espi_saf_flash_write
methods.description: Writes data to the attached flash component.

methods.name: espi_saf_flash_erase
methods.description: Erases data on the attached flash component.

methods.name: espi_saf_flash_unsuccess
methods.description: Responds that a flash transaction was unsuccessful.

methods.name: espi_saf_init_callback
methods.description: Initializes an espi_callback structure with handler and event type.

methods.name: espi_saf_add_callback
methods.description: Registers a callback for eSPI events.

methods.name: espi_saf_remove_callback
methods.description: Unregisters a callback for eSPI events.
